verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own docs say its SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device, with prompts, audio, and images staying on the phone and no network needed. They also say the CLI runs local models offline without an account, and that hosted execution happens only when explicitly chosen. A community reply in the Hacker News thread corroborates that it is fully local with no data collected; install and segfault bug reports concern reliability, not where data goes. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of no network egress or telemetry.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
A request only leaves your machine _when you say so_.
Hosted and local execution are explicit choices. Wally does not silently move a request between them.
Fully local - no data is collected!!
